title: RecordStore.Mark.holds skips the cloud-erase comparison once the store has no cloud erase, so a mark taken in the cloud still holds after the cloud disconnects (PR 1218 round 3, F6)
evidence: Owner's ruling (side-compare, no chat change): RecordStore.applyNow(_:on:) (RecordStore+Mark.swift) now also requires both marks on the same side, mark.holds(at: now) && (mark.erase == nil) == (now.erase == nil), so an Apple Health batch read on the cloud writes nothing on the phone's file and retries silently (US-72 AC10, US-25 AC11o). Mark.holds is unchanged, so the chat still reads connecting or disconnecting as no erase (US-67 AC5). RecordSourcePinsTests testACloudMarkDoesNotLandOnThePhoneRecord (failed first). Was: RecordStore+Mark.swift:17
